dedupe_keys.name: big box retail grocery store and electric vehicle station load profiles

description: Big Box Retail Grocery Store and Electric Vehicle Station Load Profiles is a dataset listed in Open Energy Hub (ORNL), an energy-sector data hub, published or maintained by Oak Ridge National Laboratory for the U.S. DOE Office of Electricity. This dataset includes yearlong, one-minute resolution time series profiles for the big box retail grocery stores stores simulated in Phoenix, Houston, Denver, and Minneapolis, as well as electric vehicle charging time series profiles for the various ports, charging levels, and station utilizations produced for the study "Impact of electric vehicle charging on the power demand ... Coverage: the United States. The portal files it under Transportation, Electricity. Its keywords are electric vehicles, electric load, load timeseries, retail stores. The portal shows 2024-06-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is National Laboratory of the Rockies License (https://data.nrel.gov/node/182/license). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oeh-open-data-portal.
